review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that with the rapid growth of modern technology, people can see historical objects and works of art easily and public museums and art galleries are unnecessary. Personally, I am of the opposite school of thought.

Admittedly, technology can provide a valuable insight into historical objects and artworks. This is primarily because high-resolution images, three-dimensional reconstructions, virtual reality platforms enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable detail without leaving home. To illustrate, Louvre museum in France can offer online collection that helps viewers access to artworks more easily with free or very low charge. In this way, art lovers around the world can enjoy and be motivated to develop an interest in artistic. Moreover, technology can help those who cannot afford and have mobility issues still access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, there are justifiable reasons to believe that the roles of public museums and art galleries are undeniable. Chief of these is that online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artwork in person as it can evoke emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images cannot convey. This can be seen in the way when students see soldier uniforms in a war museum, they can understand suffering that death soldiers and past generations have experienced. Furthermore, museums and galleries are vital cultural hubs, symbolizing the identity of a region. In this way, they are the magnet for tourism and the facilitator of bonding within the community.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that although technology can help people access to cultural and historical heritages more easily, the necessity of public museums and art galleries is undeniable.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài đầy đủ.

review.overall: Em giữ lập trường phản đối rõ từ mở đến kết, và ví dụ học sinh nhìn quân phục là ý riêng phù hợp. Tuy vậy, nhiều lỗi thuộc khung đã học vẫn còn: “as it can evoke emotions” để nguồn cảm xúc mơ hồ, dễ đảo ý; “the way when” trộn hai cách mở ví dụ; “an interest in artistic” dùng tính từ sau giới từ. Bài còn ẩu ở khâu tự soát. Em cần nghiêm túc, cầu thị đọc từng chú thích, sửa trọn câu rồi kiểm xem ví dụ quân phục thực sự chứng minh trải nghiệm trực tiếp trước khi nộp.

task.text:
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed because people can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
